messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Hosted API queue growth detected in us-east-1 (p95 > 2.5s, queue depth 18k). Auto-priority: P1. Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/3234567890 :rotating_light:
Amanda Li: seeing massive backlog on the hosted queue, calls timing out at client side. Customers reporting 504s.
PJ: confirm - metrics show autoscaler attempted scale but failed to provision new GPU nodes: 
```
  provisioner: create_instance -> error: quota_exceeded (GPUs)
  autoscaler: stuck in backoff, last_scale_attempt=15m
```
Rajesh: oncall here. paging SRE. What is the impact window? any customers on dedicated we need to protect?
Leo: impact: high; p95 token latency jumped from 120ms -> 2.8s, p99 ~ 9s on text-generation. Hosted quota for g5s in us-east seems exhausted. Dedicated customers unaffected if pinned, but default routing is still sending to hosted pools.
Nina Park: are any ops runbooks applicable? can we reroute traffic to other regions or model variants?
Sam T: trying fallback routing now. Running: 
```
# enable fallback to eu-west for non-geo-locked requests
redwoodctl route set --scope hosted --fallback-region eu-west-1 --reason "emergency us-east GPU quota"
```
Amanda Li: watch client-affinity. Some keys are region-locked. We should only reroute best-effort customers. Add a slow ramp and check error rates.
PJ: autoscaler logs show cloud API 429s when creating instances, and cloud console shows we've hit soft quota for GPUs. We requested quota increase earlier but not approved yet.
incident-bot: New action: page SRE Pager, infra-oncall-bot.
SRE Pager: on it. Quick ask: can we temporarily throttle lower-tier tokens? throttle_policy exists per-tenant.
Rajesh: yes apply rate limit to free-tier and default plans. Command: 
```
redwoodctl quotas update --tenant default --qps 5 --reason "emergency throttle to reduce queue"
```
Leo: applying now. Expect to see ingress drop and queue stop growing in ~30s.
Nina Park: also enable model-variant downgrade for latency-sensitive customers: switch some routes from large-24 to large-16-quantized for hosted fallback. That reduces GPU memory and allows packing.
Sam T: executing canary switch for 5% traffic: 
```
redwoodctl rollout set --route /v1/generate --from large-24 --to large-16-q --percent 5
```
Amanda Li: FYI customers reporting partial successes then timeouts. We need to communicate status to support. Sam, can you notify support with ETA?
Sam T: pinged #support-status and wrote a short blurb: "We are experiencing elevated request latencies and timeouts in us-east-1 due to GPU capacity exhaustion. Mitigations in progress: throttling lower-tier traffic, enabling cross-region fallback, and rolling out smaller model variants. Updates every 15m." :information_source:
PJ: provisioning still failing for some instance types. Trying alternative instance family that uses different quota pool (nvidia-a100 -> nvidia-a10x). Might reduce perf but should relieve backlog.
Rajesh: careful with memory and kv-cache compat. Need to transcode models.
Leo: can we spin up temporary burst nodes in eu-west and route a larger share? That needs DNS and latency checks.
Sam T: increased eu-west fallback to 30% for non-geo-locked keys. Monitoring errors.
Amanda Li: can we enable eviction policy to preempt low-priority jobs in the pool? That might free KV cache memory and free slots.
PJ: eviction triggered. commands: 
```
redwoodctl pool evict --pool hosted-us-east-1 --policy preempt-low-priority --threshold 0.85
```
incident-bot: Automation attempted to evict 120 low-priority tasks, reclaimed 18 GPU slots.
Leo: seeing queue slope flatten, p95 trending down to ~1.4s, p99 to ~4.2s. Good.
Nina Park: however some customers are still timing out; support needs per-tenant impact list. Sam/T can you attach list?
Sam T: generating impacted tenants list: `curl https://ops.redwood/internal/impact?alert=3234567890` -> returned 42 tenants with >1% error increase. Pushing to support.
Rajesh: cloud quota update came back APPROVED for +20 GPUs but allocation will take ~18 minutes. We'll have new capacity soon.
Amanda Li: plan: short-term (0-30m) throttling + fallback + model downgrade; medium (30-60m) provision new GPUs + drain backlog; long-term action items after incident.
SRE Pager: starting timeline notes for handoff. Need summary and what to monitor overnight.
PJ: FYI: autoscaler had a bug where backoff reset wasn't respecting manual override; I pushed a hotfix branch and deployed. Hotfix command: 
```
gitops deploy autoscaler --ref fix/backoff-reset --env hosted-us-east-1
```
incident-bot: Deploy job started, CI passed, canary to 2 nodes.
Leo: can confirm canary nodes accepted traffic and scaled local queue down ~12%.
Nina Park: support posted to customers with affected keys saying "We are mitigating; some requests may be rate-limited. Full capacity restoration ETA ~30-60m." :white_check_mark:
Sam T: new GPUs came up in ~20m. Autoscaler reconciled and started draining backlog. Observed backlog drop: 18k -> 2.5k over 14m.
Amanda Li: excellent. Any customers still at elevated errors?
Sam T: 6 tenants still >5% error rate; flagged for priority follow-up by CSM.
Rajesh: doing final validation of fallback consistency and KV cache warmups. Some degraded responses due to model mismatch but acceptable for now.
PJ: scheduling post-incident: root cause seems to be unexpected cross-customer surge plus quota exhaustion and autoscaler backoff bug. Need ticket for quota policy, autoscaler resilience, proactive quota forecasts.
SRE Pager: Handoff summary for next oncall:
- Status: backlog draining, stable p95 ~180-250ms, p99 ~750-950ms, queue ~1.2k and decreasing
- Actions taken: throttled lower-tier, cross-region fallback, model downgrade canary, eviction of low-priority tasks, hotfix to autoscaler backoff, emergency quota increase requested
- Next watch: ensure queue continues to drain, ensure no regression when we disable throttles, follow customers in support list
- Oncall contact: Rajesh (primary), PJ (backup)
Amanda Li: thanks all. I'll own the incident writeup + customer impact summary. Please add any todo items.
PJ: TODOs: 1) quota forecasting automation, 2) autoscaler backoff fix into mainline with tests, 3) improved per-tenant throttling telemetry
Nina Park: TODO: update playbook to include model-variant downgrade steps and cross-region fallback checklist
Sam T: posted preliminary incident notes to #postmortems/incidents/3234567890 and attached graphs.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (status: mitigated) — no active P1.
SRE Pager: handing off to overnight. leaving monitoring hooks + escalation plan. Good work team :clap:"
